title: The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited has a long-standing commitment to community development, spanning over 40 years. Their initiatives have directly benefited around half a million farmers in the last decade alone. Since 1952, they have provided scholarships to students, contributing to the growth of various industries in Nigeria. Recently, they have focused on training youths in the Niger Delta in various trades, such as carpentry and mechanics, to empower them to start their own businesses. Additionally, they are involved in building and refurbishing hospitals in rural areas, demonstrating their dedication to improving the quality of life in the communities where they operate.
